roadmap.title: Leon first run and broad collection
roadmap.description: Play Leon on Assisted or Standard; collect his 40 files, available Mr. Raccoons, six Hip Pouches, and eight locks while completing combat and set-piece tasks.

roadmap.title: Claire first run and exclusive collection
roadmap.description: Play Claire; collect her 12 exclusive files and three exclusive Mr. Raccoons, then complete Sherry's timed escape and Claire's timed final boss.

roadmap.title: Second runs, S ranks, and Hardcore
roadmap.description: Finish both 2nd Runs for the true ending and six exclusive files. Use familiar routes for each character's S-rank and Hardcore clear, overlapping runs when comfortable.

roadmap.title: Restriction-run cleanup
roadmap.description: Use a short Assisted 2nd Run for the no-healing, no-item-box, and 14,000-step requirements.

roadmap.title: Bonus modes and Ghost Survivors
roadmap.description: Complete The 4th Survivor, destroy all ten Ghost Survivors Mr. Raccoons, unlock No Way Out, and finish its 100-zombie Normal challenge.

achievements.displayName: Welcome to the City of the Dead
achievements.description: Make it to the police station.
achievements.summary: Reach the @loc{Raccoon Police Department} during either character's campaign.

guide.context: This is mandatory story progress and works on every difficulty and scenario.

steps.text: Follow the streets route after the gas-station prologue and enter the @loc{RPD Main Hall}.

achievements.description: Solve the Goddess Statue puzzle.
achievements.summary: Place all three medallions in the @loc{RPD Main Hall} Goddess Statue.

guide.context: The Lion, Unicorn, and Maiden medallions are mandatory key items obtained by solving their three statue puzzles.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Lion, Unicorn, and Maiden Medallions}, insert all three into the Goddess Statue, and open the underground passage.

achievements.description: Escape the police station.
achievements.summary: Escape the @loc{Raccoon Police Department} through the Parking Garage route.

guide.context: This unlocks through mandatory campaign progress after the second extended RPD visit.

steps.text: Complete the character-specific electrical-panel objective, obtain the @item{Parking Garage Keycard}, and leave the garage.

achievements.description: Complete Ada's segment.
achievements.summary: Finish Ada's playable segment during @npc{Leon's} campaign.

guide.context: Ada's sequence is mandatory in either Leon scenario and cannot be accessed as Claire.

steps.text: Use the @item{EMF Visualizer} to trace and hack the highlighted power circuits, escape the Incinerator, and finish Ada's sewer route.

achievements.description: Complete Sherry's segment.
achievements.summary: Finish Sherry's playable segment during @npc{Claire's} campaign.

guide.context: Sherry's sequence is mandatory in either Claire scenario and cannot be accessed as Leon.

steps.text: Escape the bedroom, avoid Chief Irons through the orphanage, and complete the Director's Room hiding sequence.

achievements.displayName: A Great Need for a Shower
achievements.description: Escape from the sewers.
achievements.summary: Escape the @loc{Sewers} and ride the cable car to the @loc{Laboratory}.

guide.context: The achievement follows the mandatory plug puzzle and Stage 2 G encounter.

steps.text: Open the U-Area door with the six chess plugs, defeat Stage 2 G, reunite with your companion, and activate the cable car.

achievements.description: Complete Leon's story.
achievements.summary: Complete any first or second-run campaign as @npc{Leon}.

guide.context: Difficulty and rank do not matter for this character-specific story clear.

steps.text: Defeat Super Tyrant, use the rocket launcher to finish the fight, and reach Leon's ending.

achievements.description: Complete Claire's story.
achievements.summary: Complete any first or second-run campaign as @npc{Claire}.

guide.context: Difficulty and rank do not matter for this character-specific story clear.

steps.text: Defeat Stage 4 G before the detonation timer expires and reach Claire's ending.

achievements.description: Witness the true ending.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{New Game [2nd Run]} as either character to witness the true ending.

guide.context: A first-run Leon clear unlocks Claire's 2nd Run, while a first-run Claire clear unlocks Leon's 2nd Run.

steps.text: Finish one first-run campaign and select the opposite character under @mechanic{New Game [2nd Run]}.
Complete that 2nd Run and defeat the final train encounter to view the extended ending.

achievements.description: Combine two items together.
achievements.summary: Combine any two compatible items in the inventory.

guide.context: Compatible pairs include herbs, gunpowder recipes, key-item components, and weapon parts.

steps.text: Select one inventory item, choose @mechanic{Combine}, and select its compatible partner.

achievements.description: Increase your inventory slots.
achievements.summary: Collect any @item{Hip Pouch} to add two inventory slots.

guide.context: The earliest pouch is inside the West Office safe and is available before leaving the RPD.

steps.text: At @loc{RPD 1F — West Office}, open the safe with left 9, right 15, left 7 and take the Hip Pouch.

achievements.description: Customize a weapon.
achievements.summary: Attach any compatible weapon part to its weapon.

guide.context: An early handgun part is inside Leon's locked desk in the West Office.

steps.text: Open the @loc{West Office} desk with left code @mechanic{NED} and right code @mechanic{MRG}, then collect the weapon part.
In the inventory, combine the part with its named weapon.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with a knife.
achievements.summary: Kill any enemy with direct @item{Combat Knife} slashes.

guide.context: A defensive knife counter alone is not the intended finish; weaken a zombie first to conserve durability.

steps.text: Stagger or down a zombie, equip the Combat Knife, and slash until that enemy dies.

achievements.description: Counterattack with a sub-weapon.
achievements.summary: Break an enemy grab by countering with a knife, grenade, or flash grenade.

guide.context: The equipped sub-weapon must be in your inventory when the defensive prompt appears.

steps.text: Keep the sub-weapon in your inventory, allow a zombie to seize you, and activate the defensive prompt.

achievements.description: Use Wooden Boards to board up a window.
achievements.summary: Use a @item{Wooden Board} to barricade an open RPD window.

guide.context: Only windows showing the interaction prompt accept boards; several appear along required RPD routes.

steps.text: Carry a Wooden Board to a barricadable @loc{RPD} window and use the interaction prompt.

achievements.description: Destroy a Mr. Raccoon.
achievements.summary: Shoot or strike any mechanical @item{Mr. Raccoon} bobblehead.

guide.context: The first easy target is on a dark shelf along the north side of the West Office.

steps.text: At @loc{RPD 1F — West Office}, listen for the mechanical rattle and destroy the Mr. Raccoon on the north shelf.

achievements.description: Open a portable safe.
achievements.summary: Solve either randomized @item{Portable Safe} button puzzle.

guide.context: The two Portable Safes are in the Shower Room and Linen Room; their solutions differ between saves.

steps.text: Examine a Portable Safe and press its eight buttons in an order that lights adjacent lamps around the entire green ring without breaking the sequence.

achievements.description: Open a dial safe.
achievements.summary: Open the @loc{West Office} dial safe with left 9, right 15, left 7.

guide.context: This is the earliest fixed-combination safe and also contains a Hip Pouch.

steps.text: Turn the West Office safe dial to @mechanic{left 9, right 15, left 7}, confirming each number without overshooting.

achievements.description: Shoot the grenade you fed to an enemy.
achievements.summary: Counter a zombie with a frag grenade, then shoot the grenade while it remains in the zombie's mouth.

guide.context: The opening room of either 2nd Run places a grenade close to several zombies for a quick retry.

steps.text: Carry a @item{Frag Grenade}, allow a zombie grab, and use the defensive counter prompt.
Aim immediately at the lodged grenade and shoot it before it detonates normally.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies at once with a sub-weapon.
achievements.summary: Kill at least three enemies simultaneously with one sub-weapon explosion.

guide.context: The opening area of either 2nd Run supplies a frag grenade and a convenient zombie group.

steps.text: Gather three or more zombies into a tight cluster and throw one @item{Frag Grenade} into their center so the same blast kills all three.

achievements.description: Shoot a zombie dog or a licker out of the air.
achievements.summary: Shoot a Zombie Dog during its leap or a Licker while it is airborne.

guide.context: Zombie Dogs around Leon's Parking Garage route or Claire's Orphanage route give the most predictable attempts.

steps.text: Keep a shotgun or rapid-fire weapon aimed at a Zombie Dog, wait for its jumping attack, and shoot before it lands.

achievements.description: Paralyze a licker's sense of hearing.
achievements.summary: Hit a @enemy{Licker} with a @item{Flash Grenade} to disable its hearing.

guide.context: For an early attempt, take the Flash Grenade from @loc{S.T.A.R.S. Office}; a Licker patrols immediately beyond its doorway.

steps.text: Equip a Flash Grenade, approach a Licker, and throw the grenade close enough for the flash to stun it.

achievements.description: Shoot Tyrant's hat off his head.
achievements.summary: Shoot @enemy{Mr. X's} fedora off during his RPD pursuit.

guide.context: Mr. X begins pursuing both characters after the rooftop fire is extinguished; damaging him only causes temporary staggers.

steps.text: When Mr. X approaches in an open corridor, aim at his fedora and fire until the hat falls off.

achievements.description: Defeat Stage 2 G using the crane only once.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Stage 2 G} by calling the crane container back exactly once.

guide.context: Make a manual save after completing the Monitor Room chess-plug puzzle. If one return impact does not finish G, reload instead of calling the crane again.

steps.text: On the boss platform, press the panel once to send the shipping container away.
Use your strongest weapons until G has fallen to his knees about five times, then stagger him within the container's path.
Press the panel once more to call the container back; stay outside its path and let that first return impact knock G into the abyss.

achievements.description: Using the photo hints, find 2 hidden items.
achievements.summary: Develop the @item{Hiding Place} film, then collect both photographed items in the RPD.

guide.context: The Sewers cable car is a point of no return, so complete the RPD backtrack before activating it.

steps.text: Use the T-Bar valve in the Lower Waterway, ride the Workroom Lift, and take the Hiding Place film from the @loc{Sewers Upper Workroom}.
Return through the Workers' Break Room shortcut and develop the film in the @loc{RPD Dark Room}.
Claim one photographed stash from the @loc{Press Room} desk, then open the concealed lower compartment of Wesker's @loc{S.T.A.R.S. Office} desk.

achievements.description: Expand inventory slots to max.
achievements.summary: Collect all six @item{Hip Pouches} in one Assisted or Standard campaign to reach 20 slots.

guide.context: Hardcore removes some pouches. Each pouch adds two slots to the starting eight, and the six pickups do not carry into another campaign.

collectibles.name: West Office safe
collectibles.method: Open the safe with left 9, right 15, left 7.

collectibles.name: West Storage table
collectibles.method: Take the pouch from the table beside Some Guy's Scribblings.

collectibles.name: Operators Room locker
collectibles.method: After completing the campaign's first boss fight, enter the @loc{Underground Facility Middle — Operators Room} safe room and open the locker immediately right of its typewriter.

collectibles.name: Safety Deposit locker 203
collectibles.method: Solve the Shower Room and Linen Room Portable Safes, install both Spare Parts in the keypad, and open locker 203.

collectibles.name: Workroom table
collectibles.method: Open the Lower Waterway T-Bar valve, ride the Workroom Lift, and take the pouch from the table.

collectibles.name: Nap Room bed
collectibles.method: Tune the Signal Modulator to the panel's frequency, restore power, and take the pouch from the revealed bed.

achievements.description: Use only the EMF Visualizer to complete Ada's gameplay segment.
achievements.summary: Complete Ada's playable segment without firing her handgun; use only the @item{EMF Visualizer}.

guide.context: This is Leon-only. Make a manual save after the crocodile so an accidental shot can be retried without replaying the campaign.

steps.text: When control switches to Ada, leave the handgun unused and keep the EMF Visualizer equipped.
Trace yellow wiring through walls, hold the scan on each highlighted control box until it overloads, and use the hacked doors and lift to advance.
Hack the Incinerator's three circuits before time expires and complete the remaining segment without firing the handgun.

achievements.description: Escape the bedroom within 60 seconds during Sherry's segment.
achievements.summary: As Sherry, solve the block puzzle, take the scissors, and leave the bedroom within 60 seconds.

guide.context: This is Claire-only. The block order is randomized initially but remains unchanged after reloading, so solve it once, note the moves, then reload to reset the timer.

steps.text: Immediately take the stuffed doll from the chair, examine its back, remove the block, and insert it into the puzzle box by the door.
Rotate and reorder the blocks until every adjacent symbol joins correctly, then take the scissors.
Use the scissors on the cardboard panel, crawl through the opening, and leave the bedroom before 60 seconds elapse.

achievements.description: Defeat Stage 4 G with 4+ minutes left until detonation.
achievements.summary: As Claire, defeat @enemy{Stage 4 G} with at least 4:00 remaining on the detonation timer.

guide.context: The escape begins with ten minutes. Assisted difficulty and the supplied minigun make the damage check substantially easier.

steps.text: Reach the train platform quickly, target G's exposed eyes with your strongest ammunition, and use the minigun whenever the eyes are visible.
Finish Stage 4 G before the countdown drops below @mechanic{4:00}.

achievements.displayName: In the Blink of an Eye
achievements.description: Defeat Super Tyrant with 5+ minutes left until detonation.
achievements.summary: As Leon, defeat @enemy{Super Tyrant} with at least 5:00 remaining on the detonation timer.

guide.context: The escape begins with ten minutes. Survive while dealing steady damage until the rocket launcher is dropped.

steps.text: Reach the lift promptly, damage Super Tyrant with high-power weapons while avoiding his charge, then use the supplied rocket launcher immediately.
End the fight before the countdown drops below @mechanic{5:00}.

achievements.summary: Read all @item{58 files} across Leon A, Claire A, Leon B, and Claire B.

achievements.description: Destroy all Mr. Raccoons.
achievements.summary: Destroy all @item{15 Mr. Raccoons} across the two characters and a 2nd Run.

guide.context: Destroyed targets save to the profile immediately. Leon has two route-exclusive targets, Claire has three, and the final opening-area target requires either 2nd Run.

collectibles.name: Nine shared-route targets
collectibles.method: Destroy the targets in the West Office; S.T.A.R.S. Office; Firing Range; RPD 2F hall opened by Leon's crank or Claire's Heart Key route; corridor west of the Clock Tower; Lower Sewers corridor before Supplies Storage; Laboratory Cafeteria; Laboratory Nap Room; and either 2nd Run's opening bushes left of the stairs.

collectibles.name: Three Leon-route targets
collectibles.location: @loc{Break Room, sewer entrance, and Ada's Incinerator}
collectibles.method: Destroy the target behind the briefcase in the Break Room; the target immediately after the crocodile before climbing the sewer ladder; and the target on the floor beside the Incinerator door during Ada's segment.

collectibles.name: Three Claire-route targets
collectibles.method: Destroy the target behind the Heart Key door in East Storage; the target at the front of the bus after the Basketball Court; and the target on a Nursery shelf at the Orphanage.

achievements.description: Open all of the safes and locks in the game.
achievements.summary: Open all eight fixed safes and locks in one campaign.

guide.context: The two randomized Portable Safes do not count. Leon's desk has two independent locks, producing eight required openings from seven containers.

collectibles.name: Treatment Pool safe

achievements.description: Complete Leon's story on Standard or Hardcore with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Finish Leon's story with an S rank on Standard or Hardcore.

guide.context: Only final clear time determines S rank. Assisted does not qualify, and choosing Continue after death retains the failed attempt's time.

steps.text: Clear Leon A within @mechanic{3:30:00} or Leon's 2nd Run within @mechanic{3:00:00} on Standard; Hardcore thresholds are 2:30:00 and 2:00:00.
Pause when planning, skip unnecessary fights and detours, and after any death quit to the title screen and reload instead of choosing Continue.

achievements.description: Complete Claire's story on Standard or Hardcore with an S rank.
achievements.summary: Finish Claire's story with an S rank on Standard or Hardcore.

guide.context: Only final clear time determines S rank. Assisted does not qualify, and save count does not affect an S rank.

steps.text: Clear Claire A within @mechanic{3:30:00} or Claire's 2nd Run within @mechanic{3:00:00} on Standard; Hardcore thresholds are 2:30:00 and 2:00:00.
Follow only required objectives and, after a death, quit to the title screen and reload so the failed attempt's time is removed.

achievements.description: Complete Leon's story on "Hardcore" game mode.
achievements.summary: Complete any Leon campaign on @mechanic{Hardcore} difficulty.

guide.context: Hardcore removes autosaves, requires Ink Ribbons at typewriters, and makes enemies much more dangerous. The infinite Samurai Edge earned from a Standard S rank is permitted.

steps.text: Begin Leon A or Leon's 2nd Run on Hardcore and collect Ink Ribbons for manual saves.
Stagger ordinary enemies instead of clearing every room, save after successful objective loops, and reserve strong ammunition for bosses.
Defeat Super Tyrant and complete Leon's ending without changing difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete Claire's story on "Hardcore" game mode.
achievements.summary: Complete any Claire campaign on @mechanic{Hardcore} difficulty.

guide.context: Hardcore removes autosaves, requires Ink Ribbons at typewriters, and makes enemies much more dangerous. The infinite Samurai Edge earned from a Standard S rank is permitted.

steps.text: Begin Claire A or Claire's 2nd Run on Hardcore and collect Ink Ribbons for manual saves.
Use staggers to pass normal enemies, save after productive route segments, and conserve high-damage rounds for G encounters.
Defeat Stage 4 G and complete Claire's ending without changing difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete the game without using a recovery item.
achievements.summary: Complete an entire campaign without using any recovery item.

guide.context: Assisted difficulty's automatic regeneration to 50% health is allowed; herbs, mixed herbs, and First Aid Sprays are not.

steps.text: Start a familiar Assisted campaign and never select @mechanic{Use} on any healing item.
Save frequently, avoid optional rooms and fights, and rely on Assisted regeneration after reaching safety.
Complete the final boss and ending with zero recovery items used.

achievements.description: Clear the game without opening the item box.
achievements.summary: Complete an entire campaign without opening an item box.

guide.context: Even one interaction invalidates the run. Infinite weapons cannot be used because they begin inside the item box.

steps.text: Start a familiar Assisted campaign, ignore every item box, and collect available Hip Pouches for capacity.
Carry only required keys and efficient weapons, combine ammunition when useful, and discard exhausted keys or low-value supplies.
Complete the final boss and ending without interacting with any item box.

achievements.description: Take 14000 steps or fewer in one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Complete one campaign in no more than @mechanic{14,000 steps}.

guide.context: A 2nd Run is shorter. The live total appears under Pause > Records > A Small Carbon Footprint.

steps.text: Use a familiar Assisted 2nd Run, collect only required keys and weapons, and avoid collectible detours or unnecessary backtracking.
Check @mechanic{Pause > Records > A Small Carbon Footprint} at major transitions and reload if a routing mistake adds excessive travel.
Complete the ending while the record remains at 14,000 steps or fewer.

achievements.description: Complete The 4th Survivor extra mode.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The 4th Survivor} by escorting HUNK from the Sewers to the RPD entrance.

guide.context: The mode unlocks after completing a first run and the opposite character's 2nd Run. Its fixed inventory and enemy layout reward routing over full room clears.

steps.text: Complete one first-run story and its opposite-character @mechanic{New Game [2nd Run]}, then select The 4th Survivor from Extra Modes.
Move continuously toward the RPD entrance, stagger or dodge blockers, use the red-blue herb mixture before dangerous sewer grabs, and preserve grenades for the crowded final exterior stretch.
Reach the front gate alive to finish HUNK's scenario.

achievements.description: Complete the No Way Out scenario without training mode.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{No Way Out} without Training by killing all @mechanic{100 zombies}.

guide.context: Unlock the final Ghost Survivors chapter by clearing all three earlier stories. No Time to Mourn is the first, Runaway is the second, and Forgotten Soldier is the third; Normal or Training clears work for this prerequisite, but the achievement run must use Normal.

steps.text: Complete the first three Ghost Survivors chapters, then launch @mechanic{No Way Out} without Training enabled.
Kill backpack zombies to obtain their weapons. From kill 10 onward, shoot gas-tank zombies in the legs when practical so their dropped tanks remain available as group explosives.
Use powerful ammunition on armored and pale enemies, preserve shotgun and Spark Shot resources for dangerous targets, and detonate saved tanks when dense groups enter.
Survive inside the gas station until the counter reaches @mechanic{100 kills} and the chapter completion screen appears.

achievements.description: Destroy all Mr. Raccoons hidden in The Ghost Survivors mode.
achievements.summary: Destroy all @item{10 Mr. Raccoons} hidden across the four Ghost Survivors chapters.

guide.context: Destruction records persist. No Time to Mourn has two route-exclusive targets, so its four targets require at least two runs.

collectibles.name: No Time to Mourn — four targets
collectibles.method: Destroy the target right of the starting exit; below and right before the backpack-zombie room; after the RPD lift, take the left route downstairs and shoot the target above a barrel at the dead end; on another run take the right route, descend the next lift, continue left to the Ivy, and shoot the target in the opening behind it.

collectibles.name: Runaway — three targets
collectibles.method: Destroy the target on the bench behind the backpack zombie near the Licker; inside the ambulance before the Parking Garage; and, after the Jail doors open, backtrack through the right-hand door and shoot the target in the middle cell.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Soldier — two targets
collectibles.method: After the Pump Room elevator rises, remain inside and look below the railing; while the Laboratory exit door opens, wait for Mr. X to leave the Security Room, enter it, and shoot the target beside the computer.

collectibles.name: No Way Out — final target
collectibles.method: Watch the doors zombies break through and shoot the target behind one of those doors during the brief period when it remains open.

achievements.description: Read a letter left behind by Jill.
achievements.summary: As Leon, read Jill's letter on the counter inside @loc{Kendo Gun Shop}.

guide.context: The letter is available in either Leon scenario after leaving the RPD through the Parking Garage; Claire does not visit this shop.

steps.text: Progress Leon's story until the Parking Garage gate opens, then follow Ada into Kendo Gun Shop.
Before leaving the shop, interact with @item{Jill's Letter} on the counter and open the document.
